title: Findshape
summary:
Findshape is a Casterwill spell that repairs objects that have been damaged or destroyed. More complex objects often take greater amounts of concentration to repair.

The spell manifested itself as a violet aura on the object itself the first time, then as a yellow stream travelling toward its target every other time.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
This spell was used by Sophie Casterwill to repair a Shogi tile, a vase, and after much concentration, to finally repair Eathon Lambert's journal. [The Unseen Guide]

In The Professor's castle, Sophie used Findshape on a cracked area of floor to trap Behemoth's foot. [The Mission]

In Peru, Sophie used Findshape on the cracked Nexus to restore it, in order to contact Eathon Lambert with the powers of Janusea the Gatekeeper. The fight with Wilder's suits outside made rocks fall on the Nexus, causing it to crack, and disrupt the connection. Sophie tried to use Findshape to fix it several times, but in the end, the Nexus cracked completely, terminating the connection with Eathon. [Doorway to Huntik]

During the war against the Blood Spiral, Nimue Casterwill used this spell to restore the cliff side to its original shape, thus removing the pathway to the Fortress of Iron Will. [The Spiral War]
